theorems.name: Submission.coarea_normDet_adjoint_eq_horizontal
theorems.statement: ∀ {X Y : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup X] [InnerProductSpace ℝ X] [FiniteDimensional ℝ X] [NormedAddCommGroup Y] [InnerProductSpace ℝ Y] [FiniteDimensional ℝ Y] (P : X →ₗ[ℝ] Y), (Function.Surjective P → (LinearMap.adjoint P).normDet = (P ∘ₗ (LinearMap.ker P)ᗮ.subtype).normDet) ∧ (¬ Function.Surjective P → (LinearMap.adjoint P).normDet = 0)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
